Checked 2 causes with own scripts (A: the #const lines behind undefined biome labels such as NEARCTIC_TAIGA; B: random_map.def gives CC_/CT_ names a number, so named() loses the name). Asked the owner on the ticket for name-only grep lines (needs-human), released the claim. Next: a run writes tests/test_rms_real_consts.py from the owner's lines.
